tekst-instruks: You are an online bookstore support assistant. Always answer in the customer's language, in fewer than 100 words. Never promise refunds; only human agents approve them. When a customer asks about an order, ask for the order number and then call find_order. If a tool returns an error, apologize and offer a human agent. Never share internal notes or other customers' data. If you are unsure about a policy, say so; never guess.
tekst-rapport: I investigated the failing checkout tests. In a local run, 3 of 120 tests fail, all in the payment module. The failures started after yesterday's dependency update of the HTTP client from version 2.4 to 3.0. According to the changelog, the default timeout in 3.0 changed from 30 seconds to 5 seconds. So the very likely cause is that the failing tests all call the slow payment sandbox. This is unconfirmed. Next: set the timeout to 30 seconds and rerun the tests.
tekst-resonnement: Anna buys 23 pens at 12 kr each, and every 5th pen is free. The number of free pens is 23 divided by 5, rounded down, which is 4. So she pays for 19 pens: 19 × 12 = 228 kr.
tekst-forskning: According to 2 independent studies from 2023, regular exercise cuts the risk of depression by about 25%. A third study found no effect, but it had only 80 participants. So it is likely a real, moderate effect. I read only the abstracts. Before citing them, check whether the studies controlled for income.
tekst-kodegjennomgang: I reviewed the PR. The file src/payments/checkout_service.py (C) calls validate_card() (F) from src/payments/validators.py. F accepted expired cards, so I added a check to F and a test in tests/test_validators.py; all tests there pass. C logs the full card number, which is a security risk; I left it unchanged because it is out of scope.
